customers_say: Customers find the door lock easy to operate with a user-friendly app, and appreciate its impressive build quality and top-tier security features. They like its appearance, noting it looks like a simple door handle, and one customer mentions the mocha finish matches perfectly with their main door. The lock functions well, with one customer highlighting its quick face unlock capability, and customers consider it a good value for money.

reviews.author: Tamal Ghosh
reviews.title: Not flawless
reviews.body: This product is good but it has a major design flaw. None of my guests able to open the door when they leave the home. I always have to open the door if the visitor is new. Opening door from the inside is non intuitive, hidden behind the handle and very confusing. Nobody still today able to open the door in the first time without asking us to open the door for them. I think I have been using it for 3 months now and still finding a smart one who can open the door in first trial. May be I sound like too dramatic and making it a big deal on small issue.
